newsitem.title: USA: Carmike says plans Q2 "blockbuster" releases.
newsitem.headline: Carmike says plans Q2 "blockbuster" releases.

text.p: Carmike Cinemas Inc said Tuesday it sees its next few months as promising because of the films it plans to release during the second quarter.
The company said it will release "The Lost World: Jurassic Park" on May 23, "Batman and Robin" on June 20, and "Hercules" on June 27.
The company said it expects these films to become "blockbusters."
The company also said it plans to add about 250 new screens this year.
The company reported first quarter earnings per share of $0.35 versus earings of $0.20 for the same period a year ago.
The company said its "strong" first quarter earnings reflect a trend in the motion picture industry of releasing new movies throughout the year.
